artifacts.notes: Exactly 162 PDF pages: 157 imaged pages and five blank PDF pages (22, 33, 36, 51, 56). Bonn lists 140 printed pages. The receipt incorrectly calls all 162 page images; the exact PDF bytes are unchanged. No complete Eucharistic book or absence claim beyond the inspected contents is implied.
artifacts.rights_basis: The printed 1887 calendar is public domain in the United States by expired publication term. Bonn ULB marks this exact title record (https://digitale-sammlungen.ulb.uni-bonn.de/content/titleinfo/598417) Public Domain Mark 1.0. Retain the unchanged mechanical 162-page PDF with Bonn attribution; the mark is a status notice, not a licence. The contents inspected list Office rules and calendars but no Mass-reading table; register as a calendar component, not a complete Eucharistic book.

edition.title: Calendarium juxta ritum Ecclesiae Antiochenae Syrorum, Mosul 1887
